Commentary.Commentary: The track does have good pace and carry for a UAE surface. Definitely a good track to bat on but the bowlers have got encouragement too. The new ball has moved about with good bounce while the spinners have got sharp turn as well. Nevertheless, 281 isn't a huge score although competitive. If WI can get a good start, they'll back themselves. The visitors' innings isn't far away.

A good bowling performance by West Indies after losing the toss yesterday. Four Pakistan batsmen got fifties but nobody showed the temperament to stick longer. Credit to the Windies for fighting out and they did get slight help from the track. Gabriel and Bishoo were the stars while Joseph this morning ensured that there would be no heroics from the tail.

Yasir is not sure of why he went for that shot. That ends another cameo from the leg spinner. PAKISTAN BOWLED OUT FOR 281!
Time for some shots, reckons Yasir! Shorter length outside off, Yasir is not in position to pull that one but goes after it and is beaten.
Off the mark! This one is punched through covers for a single to get off the mark.
Outside off on a length, Babar punches it through mid off.

Shorter length on middle and leg, Amir works it down to fine leg for a single.
Amir stays back and defends this to covers.

Game time! The players are out in the middle. YASIR SHAH and MOHAMMAD AMIR are the two batsmen out for Pakistan. WEST INDIES begin the day with SHANNON GABRIEL and have taken the SECOND NEW BALL! Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - There is a cross breeze blowing and that could help the bowlers, reckons Bazid Khan. He opines that the moisture on the pitch seems to have gone and it might come onto the bat better, the spinners might get the ball to skid on. Ian Bishop adds that the good length area is best to bowl for the pacers and bowling on the stumps is vital. The new ball is the key for both the teams.

The visitors will hope that they can wrap this innings up early and get batting to take the game head on. How they bat in the first innings could very well decide how things pan out in this third Test.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the second day of the third and final Test between Pakistan and West Indies in Sharjah. This is the first time the visitors are ahead of the game with a fine performance on day one of the Test. Gabriel led them from the front with a testing spell and he along with Bishoo did well to keep Pakistan to 255 for 8.
...DAY 2...SESSION 1....

West Indies will be mighty pleased with their efforts but shouldn't rest on their laurels. This isn't an entirely flat batting track and it has already started turning. They will first have to wrap up the final 2 Pakistan wickets quickly and then bat really well on this surface. The home side spinners led by Yasir Shah will surely be licking their lips at the prospect of bowling on this track. Do join us tomorrow at 1130 IST for the second day's play. Till then, it's goodbye from us.

Gabriel was West Indies' hero today with good support from Bishoo who was underbowled in the first half of the day. The leg spinner showed why that was a mistake as he bowled with control. The duo shared 7 wickets between them to derail the Pakistan innings. The hosts might have been in bigger trouble had Misbah been given out lbw early on. He got lucky but couldn't escape the laws of karma as he was dismissed in a similarly confusing fashion.

Excellent day for West Indies after losing the toss on what seemed like another typical batting surface. However, that seemed like a mirage as the new ball swung and carried well to the keeper. Azhar and Shafiq fell in the very first over of the day to jolt the hosts. Fifties from Aslam, Younis, Misbah and Sarfraz drove Pakistan forward but none of them carried on to get a big score as wickets fell mostly to loose shots. Four wickets fell for just 18 runs at the fag end of the day to give West Indies the honors.
The umpires have decided that the light isn't good enough for play to continue and so THAT SHALL BE STUMPS ON DAY 1.

OUT! GONE! Floated around leg stump, Misbah goes for the reverse sweep and the ball bobbles up in the air for a while. Dowrich from behind the stumps reacts sharply and comes forward to take a catch near the short leg region.  Appeal for a catch and that's given by the umpire. The Pakistan captain isn't amused and takes the review. Did that come off the glove or off the wrist band? Numerous replays are taken by the third umpire and it's really a tough one to call. It could hit the wrist band off the glove. Remember, the third umpire has to be extremely sure if he has to overturn the on-field call. Eventually, the third umpire feels that there isn't enough evidence to overturn the call. The decision stays and Misbah has to go. It did seem that it could have hit the glove as it was very near the wrist band.
Misbah has been given out caught behind. He goes for the review.

Welcome back for the final session. Another 36 overs left in the day. West Indies will hope that their tight bowling will reward them with a wicket or two. Pakistan still not in a safe zone. The players and umpires are out there in the middle. DEVENDRA BISHOO to start proceedings after tea.
.....DAY 1, SESSION 3.....

West Indies' bowlers didn't get much help off the track but did well to keep the runs down with some tight bowling that was backed by defensive fields. Gabriel bowled another good spell and should have had the wicket of Misbah. As much as that will disappoint West Indies, they'll have to put it behind them. If they can break this stand quickly, they can hope to break into the lower half of the Pakistan batting. Join us in a while for the final session.

A very slow-paced session of Test cricket with just 67 runs added. The session started smoothly with Aslam and Younis carrying on before the latter threw away his wicket just after completing his fifty. Aslam has continued to look solid and has stitched a small partnership with Misbah to take the team to tea without further damage. The Pakistan captain was lucky to survive an lbw appeal where DRS seemingly detected an inside edge.

Dug in short outside off, Aslam is early into the pull but misses.
Good length outside off, Aslam blocks it well from the crease.
Full and outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Good length outside off, Aslam defends it nicely from the crease.
Length ball outside off, Misbah reaches out and guides it towards point.
Length ball outside off, Misbah lunges into it and steers it towards point.
Fuller outside off, Misbah gets across and pushes it towards mid on.
Fine yorker on off, excellent delivery and Misbah does well to dig it out.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.

NOT OUT! Full and wide outside off, Aslam reaches out and drills it through backward point. Blackwood gives chase and makes a sliding stop before firing the throw at the keeper's end. Dowrich whips off the bails in a flash and they refer it upstairs. Firstly, they are checking if the stop is clean and that's ticked. Replays show that Misbah was well in. Three runs added.
Appeal for a run out is sent upstairs. Misbah is the man in question.
Full and outside off, Misbah gets the stride in and defends it out.
Good length outside off, late inward movement as Misbah offers no stroke.
Length ball on off, defended off the back foot to the leg side.
Good length on middle and leg, flicked away to the leg side.
Fuller on off, Misbah shuffles and clips it towards short mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, stays on the back foot and blocks it out.
JASON HOLDER is back on.
Good length outside off, blocked well from the crease to the off side.
FOUR! PLEASING STROKE! Full and outside off, Aslam leans into it and plays a sizzling cover drive. Top timing on the stroke as it races away to the fence for a boundary.
Full and outside off, pushed gently towards cover.
Fuller on middle and off, Aslam goes across and clips it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Full and outside off, Aslam gets across and drills it towards mid on.
Full and on the pads, Aslam gets across and clips it away through square leg. A bit in the air but in the gap too. A brace to the southpaw.
Drops it a bit short outside off, Aslam cuts it away square of the wicket. Doesn't find the fence but they'll take three more.
Full and outside off, pushed firmly back to the bowler.
Drifting in from around off, Misbah sweeps it behind square for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped gently towards short mid-wicket.
Floated on middle and leg, Misbah sweeps but straight to the fielder at short fine leg.
Flatter on middle and leg, worked away through square leg for a single.
Length ball angled in on off, Misbah gets across and blocks it to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Misbah gets the stride in and blocks it to cover.
Another full ball outside off, Aslam punches it to mid off and this time they take the sharp single. Had to hurry.
Full and outside off, Aslam drives it gently towards mid off. Wanted the single but is sent back by his skipper.
Full and angling in from outside off, Aslam drives it sweetly to mid on.
Fuller outside off, Aslam gets across and drives it towards mid on.
Floated fuller outside off, Aslam reaches out and drives it gracefully through the covers. Looked set to reach the fence but the fielder does well to make the stop near the ropes. Three runs added.
Fuller ball on the pads, Misbah gets across and clips it to backward square leg. Single taken.
A bit short outside off, punched off the back foot towards point.
Drifting in around off, blocked out solidly off the back foot down the pitch.
Tossed up outside off, Misbah presses forward and defends it towards point.
Fuller on leg stump, Misbah works it to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven off the front foot to point.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.

NOT OUT! Gabriel spears in a full length ball on off, skidding in, Misbah gets forward to defend it with a straight bat but misses and is hit on the back pad. They appeal but the umpire remains unmoved. The bowler convinces his skipper for the DRS. The replays detect no inside edge and the impact is looking in line. Wait, hang on - the third umpire has decided there is some inside edge, not sure from which angle. It's conveyed to the onfield umpire who signals that the original decision stays. That's a dubious call and the West Indian players in the dressing room aren't happy. In fact, the West Indian assistant coach has gone on to meet the third umpire. Not sure if he is allowed to do that. Anyway, Misbah survives!
Shout for an lbw, not given and Holder opts for the review.
Short again and outside off, Aslam punches it off his back foot to cover-point, the fielder is standing a bit too deep and they cross for a single.
Gabriel switches to around the wicket and bowls a short ball outside off, Sami tries to cut it from the back foot but fails to connect.

Starts with a short ball wide outside off, Misbah goes on his toes and steers it through the gap at point. The fielder gives the chase and does well to pull it back just before the rope. Good running between the wickets to pick up three runs.
SHANNON GABRIEL is back on.
Drinks break...
Fuller on the pads, gets across and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted on middle, Misbah works it to short mid-wicket.
Fired in fuller on off, Misbah digs it out back to the bowler.
Slider outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Floated on off, premeditated lap sweep from Misbah down to fine leg for a brace.
Another short ball and Sami ducks under it.
Good length angled in around off, defended well down the track.
Fuller outside off, Sami presses forward and defends it well.
Short on middle and off, Aslam ducks under the bumper.
Length ball outside off, pushed off the back foot towards point.
Fuller outside off, driven firmly towards mid off.
Tossed up outside off, Misbah presses forward and smothers it to the pitch.
Quicker on middle, Misbah stays back and defends it well.
Drifting away from outside off, blocked well off the front foot to cover.
Tossed up outside off, Misbah pushes it gently to the covers.
Flatter outside off, jammed off the back foot towards point.
Drifting in from around off, defended well off the front foot down the track.
Good length outside off, steered towards point from the crease.
Shortish outside off, defended well off the back foot to cover.
Fuller outside off, Aslam gets forward and drives it back to the bowler.
Back of a length outside off, blocked off the back foot to cover.
No ball! Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one. Joseph has overstepped.
Good length outside off, blocked well from the crease.
Good length outside off, blocked well off the front foot to cover.
Drifting in on middle, Misbah gets across and nudges it past the short leg region.
Tossed up outside off, Misbah lunges into it and defends it to short cover.
Very full on off, Misbah jams it out towards mid on.
Full and on off, Misbah gets across and clips it to the leg side.
Fuller on off, Misbah gets across and pushes it towards mid on.
MISBAH-UL-HAQ is the new man in.

OUT! YOUNIS HAS THROWN IT AWAY! Not always you see this happen. Floated on off, Younis goes for the slog sweep but wasn't quite to the pitch of the ball. He knew the moment it went up in the air that he had done a mistake. Gets a top edge that lobs to mid-wicket where Johnson takes the catch with ease. Timely strike for West Indies as the partnership is broken.
Dug in short on middle, Aslam ducks under the bumper with ease.
Length ball sliding well down the leg side, no stroke offered by Aslam.
Back of a length outside off, defended off the back foot.
Pitched up outside off, Aslam gets across and drives it to mid on.
Good length well outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller outside off, Aslam drives it firmly towards mid off.
Flatter outside off, defended well off the back foot.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.

SIX! SHOT! WHAT SWAGGER! Floated on off, Younis goes across to slog-sweep way over deep mid-wicket for a big maximum. He didn't even bother seeing where the ball was going. Just looked down in absolute nonchalance as soon as the bat made contact with the ball. Brings up his 31st Test fifty. His purple patch continues.
Flighted outside off, YK gets forward and pushed it to mid on.
Drifting in on off, Younis reaches out and clips it to the leg side.
Fuller outside off, flicked away towards the square leg region.
Good length outside off, steered from the crease to the off side.
Full and outside off, Aslam pushes it to cover.
Back of a length outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, Sami defends it from the crease with a straight bat.
Good length outside off, defended well off the back foot.
5th Test fifty for Aslam. The 100-run stand between Younis and Aslam is also up.

FOUR! LUCKY RUNS! Good length angled in from outside off, Aslam pushes at it but gets an edge that flies just past gully to the third man fence. Streaky way to bring up the little milestone. Fine knock under pressure from the young man. He'll want to make it big.
Flighted outside off, bunted straight back to the bowler.
Flatter outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Darted in on middle, YK gets back and clips it to mid-wicket.
Flighted outside off, Khan leans forward and defends it solidly.
Fuller outside off, Khan leans forward and pushes it to mid off.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot to cover.
Good length around off, defended well from the crease.

ANOTHER LIFE FOR PAKISTAN! Good length outside off, Younis gets an inside edge on to the pads. The ball is near the stumps as they go for a quick single. Sami put in the dive but it might not have saved him had Blackwood gathered the ball cleanly.
Back of a length outside off, defended well off the back foot.
Shorter outside off, defended well from the crease.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot through cover for a single.
Back of a length around off, Aslam sways away from the line of that one.
Dug in short and Aslam ducks under the bumper. Too high and wide signalled.
Fuller on middle, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Flatter outside off, Aslam defends it off the front foot.
Fuller outside off, no shot offered to that one.
SIX! CLOBBERED! Where did that shot come from! Floated just outside off, Aslam winds up for the slog sweep and nails a meaty blow comfortably over wide long on. That surprised the bowler for sure.
Floated on middle, defended well off the front foot on to the track.
Fuller outside off, Younis firmly drives it towards mid off.
Length ball outside off, YK lets it pass.
Fuller outside off, Aslam gets across and jams it past mid on as the ball goes to the deep. A single taken.
Shortish outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover. Aslam wanted the single but is sent back.
Good length outside off, defended off the back foot to the off side.
Fuller on middle and leg, Younis shuffles and flicks it through mid-wicket to the deep. Three more to the total.
Beaten! Drifting in from around off, turns away sharply with bounce to beat the edge.
Tossed up fuller on leg stump, dug out towards mid on.
Floated on middle and leg, worked to square leg for a single.
Tossed up wider outside off, squeezed out to point.
Fuller on middle and off, pushed off the front foot towards mid on.
Fuller on off, worked away towards mid-wicket with soft hands.
Fuller on the pads, Aslam gets across and clips it to mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Shortish on middle, tucked off the back foot to the leg side for a single.
Full and angling in from outside off, YK drives it well towards mid off.
Full and outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Slips one down the leg side to start with, Younis fails to connect the flick.
ALZARRI JOSEPH to bowl from the other end.
Drifting in on off, Aslam looks to block but the ball goes off the inside half to short fine leg.
Very full on middle, dug out towards mid on for a single.
Tossed up fuller outside off, Aslam reaches out and jabs it to cover.
Flatter outside off, Sami camps back and blocks it well.
Flatter outside off, nudges it with soft hands as the man at gully makes a diving stop.
Tossed up well outside off, blocked well off the front foot to cover.

Welcome back for the second session. Unless the Windies break this stand soon, Pakistan may rattle up another mammoth score on the board. The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. It will be Younis Khan and Sami Aslam who will continue from where they left off. West Indies will start with ROSTON CHASE after lunch. Let's play!!!
.....DAY 1, SESSION 2.....

Gabriel was easily the standout bowler of this session as he bowled with pace and got the ball to move around. Joseph too did well although he didn't get the wickets to show for his efforts. After the initial burst with the new ball, the Windies bowlers hardly got much off the deck. They will rue the twin lives gifted to Younis, that too in a single over. The pitch has eased out and seems like a long day is in store for the Windies. Join us in a while for the second session.

An even session to start off the final Test. It didn't start well at all for Pakistan as they lost Azhar and Shafiq in the very first over of the day. The Windies pacers were breathing fire with the new ball and there was surprising lift off the deck as well. Crisis man Younis and Aslam have thereafter batted with authority. Their unbeaten partnership has neutralized the early strikes in the session.
Full toss on the pads, Younis goes across and clips it through square leg for a brace. Some confusion in the running but no harm done eventually. THAT SHALL BE LUNCH ON DAY 1.
Final ball before lunch coming up.
Good length outside off, Younis hangs back and blocks it out well.
Dug in short but very wide outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Full and outside off, Younis gets across and pushes it down the track.
Good length outside off, Younis lifts his bat to make the leave.

FOUR! WHAT A SHOT! Full and around off, Younis gets across and thumps the drive past the mid on fielder. Stunning timing as the ball rockets away to the fence for a boundary. Another signature YK stroke.
Flighted on leg stump, Sami gets well across and smothers it to the pitch.
Very full on leg stump, Sami gets across and digs it to short mid-wicket.
Slider outside off, Aslam shuffles to block but is rapped on the pads. Loud lbw appeal but there was an inside edge.
Flighted outside off, Aslam drives it firmly back to the bowler.
Tossed up fuller outside off, dug out to the short mid off region as Chase goes across to stop.
Flatter on leg stump, defended off the back foot to the leg side.
Length ball outside off, defended well off the back foot to the off side.
Good length on off, YK shuffles on the back foot and taps it towards mid on.
Fuller on middle, Younis gets across and pushes it towards mid on.
Full and outside off, nicely driven off the front foot towards mid off.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Pitched up wide outside off, Younis reaches out to that one and flays it through the covers. Picks up a couple.
A bit short and outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Flatter and full on off, Sami digs it out to the short leg region.
Drifting in on middle, Younis gets across and clips it behind square for a single.
Fired down the leg side, Khan gets across and clips it to backward square leg.
Floated on off, YK presses forward to that one and blocks it out.
Another length ball on the pads, Aslam shuffles across and times the flick sweetly through mid-wicket. A brace added.
Length ball on leg stump, SA gets across and clips it to mid on.
Length ball around leg stump, Aslam gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller and around off, Sami gets across and drives it firmly to mid on.
Full ball outside off, Sami presses forward and pushes it towards cover.
Length ball on off, Aslam defends it well from the crease.
SHANNON GABRIEL is back on.
Good length around off, YK defends it well in the crease.

ANOTHER CHANCE MISSED! What are WI doing? Chase fires this down the leg side sensing Younis' charge down the track. The batsman fails to connect the flick but it's a really tough take for Dowrich who fumbles a bit. Tough stumping chance and he tries to do it on the second attempt but cannot gather the ball. Disturbs the stumps with his gloves as Younis puts in a dive back. So much action in this ball. You cannot afford to give a batsman of Younis' caliber a chance and here WI have given two in a single over. Sloppy!
Flatter on off, defended well off the back foot.

DROPPED! WI just cannot afford to put such chances down. They gifted Younis in the last game and they've done it again. It was a tossed up ball on middle, he cannot keep the flick down and Johnson spills the chance at mid-wicket. Holder is livid with the effort. How much will this hurt WI?
Drifting in on middle, Khan gets back and clips it towards square leg.
Floated outside off, Younis goes across to that one and flicks it away through mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller outside off, Aslam gets across and pushes it to mid on.
Fuller outside off, Aslam gets well forward and smothers it to the ground.

FOUR! TOP SHOT! Floated way outside off, Aslam continues to sweep anything up to his bat and this time it's the slog sweep. Comfortably clears mid-wicket and it just goes to the fence on a few bounces.
Flighted outside off, YK gets across and drives it down the ground to long on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Khan leans forward and pushes it to cover.
Fuller outside off, YK presses forward to that one and defends it well.

WHAT HAPPENED THERE? Floated well outside off, Aslam fetches it with his awkward sweep and the ball bobbles up for a while. Johnson at short leg seemed in a daze as he didn't know where the ball went as it falls beside him. He was probably taking evasive action initially. Did it come off the boot?
Tossed up on middle and leg, Younis goes across to that one and drives it down to long on for a single.
A bit short and outside off, YK goes back to that one and cuts it to point.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side.
Fuller on off, Aslam goes across and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Flighted on middle, Younis flicks it away behind square for a single.
Short and outside off, Sami goes back and cuts it towards point.
Flatter outside off, Aslam stays back and jams it to cover.
Fuller on middle, Aslam goes back and clips it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Aslam reaches out to that one and blocks it out well.
FOUR! Loosener from Bishoo as he drops it a bit short outside off, Aslam steps out and then drags the pull through mid-wicket to find the fence.
Sliding outside off, Aslam gets back to that one and blocks it out.
DEVENDRA BISHOO comes on to bowl.
Flighted outside off, YK gets across to that one and clips it to short mid-wicket.
Drifting in on middle, Aslam goes across and sweeps it well behind square for a single.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot to the covers.
Floated on middle, Younis goes across and works it behind square for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Younis reaches out to block but gets a faint inside edge to short leg.
Tossed up on off, Younis gets across to that one and pushes it to mid on.
Bumper from Holder and Aslam ducks under it.
Full ball outside off, Aslam drives it well towards the covers.
Length ball outside off, Aslam defends it firmly from the crease.
Full and outside off, Aslam reaches out and taps it towards cover.
Length ball on middle, Aslam gets across and clips it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, Aslam gets back and jabs it to the point region.
Tossed up outside off, YK presses forward and smothers it to the ground.
Fuller outside off, Khan defends it solidly from the crease.
Low full toss on middle, YK clips it to short mid-wicket.
Drifting in on middle, Aslam gets across and sweeps it behind square for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, Aslam goes across and clips it to the leg side.
Tossed up on off, Aslam presses forward and blocks it out.
50-run stand between Younis and Aslam.
FOUR! LOOSE AND PUT AWAY! Full and drifting down the leg side, Younis shuffles across and glances it away nicely down to the fine leg fence. Easy pickings for someone of Younis' class.
Dug in short on middle, Younis ducks under the bumper.
Good length angled in on off, Aslam gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Very full and outside off, Sami jams it out towards the covers.
Short of a length outside off, Aslam rides the bounce and chops it to gully.

Full and outside off, Younis gets forward and drives it sweetly past the bowler. Samuels at mid off dives to his right to make a half-stop. The ball still goes towards the deep as the batsmen get three.
A bit short and outside off, Aslam sits back and cuts but straight to point.
Floated on middle and leg, Younis shuffles across and whips it away down to long on for a single.
Flatter on middle, Younis gets back and punches it to mid on.
Drifting in on off, Khan gets across and pushes it to short mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Younis gets right forward and defends.
Flighted on off, YK gets well forward and blocks it out solidly.
ROSTON CHASE comes on to bowl.
Dug in short on middle, Aslam ducks under the bumper.
Length ball outside off, blocked off the front foot to the covers.
Dug in short and outside off, Aslam fends it from the crease to the off side.
Shortish outside off, pushed off the back foot towards point.
Fuller and outside off, Aslam leans into it and defends it out.
Good length angled in from well outside off, no stroke offered to that one.

Drinks break....Dream start for West Indies with two wickets in the very first over of the day. Since then, Aslam and Younis have dug in to stem the rot. The new ball has swung a bit and there has been good carry off the track too.
Fuller on the pads, Aslam gets across and glances it down to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! NICELY STRUCK! Full and on the pads, Aslam gets across to that one and clips it away through square leg. Beautifully timed and although it was uppish, it was always going to the fence.
Length ball angling away well outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball angling away wide outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Full and outside off, Sami drives it firmly towards mid off.

FOUR! EDGE GOES SAFE! Length ball outside off, Sami pushes at it tentatively. Gets an outside edge that just flies past the third slip fielder. The ball races away to the third man fence. No real luck for Alzarri at the moment.
Full and outside off, a bit of shape away, Younis shoulders arms to it.
Fuller on middle and leg, Aslam gets across and tucks it behind square leg for a single.
Full and angling away well outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Full and around off, Aslam gets right forward and blocks it on to the pitch.
Back of a length outside off, Aslam stands tall and taps it towards point.
Length ball well outside off, no shot offered to that one.

FOUR! FAB SHOT! Half-volley outside off, width on offer and Younis leans into it to cream it through the covers. Elegant shot and that raced away to the fence for a boundary. He is once again looking in ominous touch.
Length ball outside off, Younis gets back and steers it towards backward point.
Full and outside off, Younis reaches out and drives it through the covers nicely. Another brace for the veteran.
Back of a length outside off, blocked off the back foot to the off side.
Shortish outside off, good pace and carry off the deck as Younis leaves it alone. Joseph is extracting good life off the deck.
Good length on off, Younis gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Good length angling away well outside off, extra bounce but the line is too wide. Aslam lets it go.
Good length on leg stump, gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! CREAMED! Fuller ball outside off, Aslam leans nicely into it and caresses it past mid off. Pure timing and that's his first boundary of the innings.
Full and outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball angling away from outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length angled away outside off, too wide to make Aslam play.
JASON HOLDER comes on to bowl.
Very full and just around off, Younis shuffles and bunts it towards mid on.
Fuller on middle and leg, Aslam gets across and clips it past mid-wicket for a single.
Good length outside off, angled away, Aslam steers it towards backward point.
Fuller and outside off, Aslam leans forward and blocks it to short cover.
Full and angling away outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Full toss outside off, Aslam drives it sweetly through the covers for a brace.
Full and outside off, firmly driven off the front foot towards mid off.
Fuller ball outside off, Younis shuffles and eases it past mid off. Mere push but once again timed it well to get a couple more.
Length ball outside off, YK stays in the crease and defends it to cover.

FOUR! TRADEMARK YOUNIS SHOT! Fuller ball on the pads, he just shuffles across and flicks it away sweetly through mid-wicket. Timed it well and that raced away even on this slow outfield towards the fence.
Length ball on leg stump, Aslam glances it to short fine leg for a single. That came off the pads, leg bye signalled.
Length ball angled away from way outside off, goes further away as Aslam lets it pass. Another brilliant take from Dowrich diving full length to his left.
Full and on leg stump, Younis gets across to flick but the ball goes off the pads down to fine leg. A couple of leg byes added.
Good length on off, Younis shuffles and taps it towards short leg.
Joseph bowls this from wide of the crease and delivers a very full ball outside off, Younis tries to drive but gets a big inside edge to short leg. Smart bowling!
Fuller this time outside off, presses forward and taps it towards point.
Good length closer to off, nipping in as Younis looks to block off the back foot. Gets a faint inside edge on to the pads.
Full and swinging in from middle stump line, Younis shuffles to flick but misses to be rapped on the front pad. Did too much off the surface.
Fuller and outside off, Aslam reaches out and squeezes it towards point.

No ball! A high full toss and Gabriel immediately has his hands up in apology. That probably slipped out of his hand as he looked for the yorker. No ball signalled for waist high full toss and seems like Gabriel has overstepped too.
Good length outside off, blocked well off the back foot to the off side.
Shortish on middle, YK tucks it past short leg for a single.

THAT'S UGLY! Dug in short on off, angled in as Younis looks to sway away from it. Kept coming in with the angle and rams him on the helmet after being hit on the chest initially. Got into a real tangle there but he seems to be fine.
Short of a length outside off, a bit wide and Younis lets it whiz past him.
Fuller on middle, Aslam shuffles and pushes it down the track past the bowler to mid on. Single taken.
Full on off, Younis gets across and clips it to short leg.
Full outside off, Younis gets the stride in and defends it towards cover.
Good length outside off, blocked well from the crease.
Full and outside off, Younis lets it pass to the keeper.
Pitched up outside off, Younis shuffles and blocks it out to short cover.
Back of a length around off, blocked solidly off the back foot on to the pitch.
Good ball! Length ball angling across Aslam who tries to fend awkwardly. Beats the outside edge due to the extra bounce.
Good length closer to off, Aslam plays it with an angled bat towards cover.
Back of a length angled away well outside off, shapes further away as Aslam lets it pass. Dowrich dives to his left to take it brilliantly.
Back of a length on middle, Aslam goes back on his toes and defends it to short mid-wicket.
Good length on middle, Aslam gets across and clips it to the leg side.
Full and on the pads, Aslam gets across and clips it to short leg.
Good length outside off, blocked well from the crease to the off side. Again a slight mix up between the two batsmen but they get the run eventually.
Beautiful delivery! Length ball angling away outside off, Aslam chases it and is beaten all ends up.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot to the covers.

No ball! RUN OUT CHANCE MISSED! Good length outside off, Younis gets back and pushes it to the off side for a quick single. There was never a run there but Aslam responds to his senior partner's call. However, Samuels' throw at the keeper's end misses and Dowrich wasn't near the stumps either. A huge reprieve for Sami. No ball signalled as Joseph had overstepped.
Fuller and on the pads, Aslam gets across and clips it through mid-wicket. Nicely timed but the slow outfield will ensure that it won't reach the fence. Three more to the total.
Length ball on off, Aslam gets across and blocks it out to the leg side.
Almost a yorker on middle, tailing in at sharp pace, Aslam just about manages to dig it out.
ALZARRI JOSEPH to share the new ball.
Good length outside off, defended well off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, Younis gets back and glides it through backward point with soft hands. A brace added.
YOUNIS KHAN walks out to bat.

OUT! GOT HIM! Brilliant review. A touch fuller on middle, nips in sharply to rap Shafiq on the front pad. Huge lbw appeal but turned down by the umpire. Holder decides to take the review after some thought. Was it doing too much off the pitch? No bat involved at all and replays confirm it. Hawk Eye shows the impact in line and it's hitting leg stump. Wow! Double delight for the Windies to start the day. Pakistan have been rattled early.
WI have taken a review for lbw against Shafiq.
Length ball outside off, shaping away, no shot offered to that one.
ASAD SHAFIQ walks out to bat.

OUT! GOLDEN DUCK FOR AZHAR! Good length outside off, a hint of shape away with extra bounce as Ali pushes tamely at it. The outside flies at comfortable height to Brathwaite at second slip. The Windies players are elated with the start.
Good length angled away closer to off, Aslam plays with an angled bat through point for a single.

The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. SAMI ASLAM and AZHAR ALI to open the batting for Pakistan. It shall be SHANNON GABRIEL to take the new ball for West Indies. Three slips, a gully and a short leg in place. Here we go!

JASON HOLDER says that they have done well to compete in this series. Opines that it's important to keep it going and end the tour on a high. Feels that they have to take their chances whenever they get into a good position in the game. Says that he is in good shape but feels he would have been happier if he had won the toss. Says that there are two changes - Dowrich and Joseph come in for Hope and Cummins.

MISBAH-UL-HAQ says that they will bat first. (On crossing Imran Khan for the most matches as Pakistan captain) Says that milestones don't matter and stresses that it's always team first. Says that his main goal is always to lead Pakistan to victory. States that it's important to improve consistently in Tests and maintain the winning habit. Feels that the track is another flat batting surface and that bowlers will have a lot of hard work to do. Says that there are two changes in the side - Riaz and Amir come in for Sohail and Rahat.
Time for the toss, Misbah to flip the coin. Heads is the call, it's a tail. Misbah's luck continues. PAKISTAN WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the final Test between Pakistan and West Indies in Sharjah. Having sealed the series in Abu Dhabi, Misbah's men will look to affect a whitewash, thereby sweeping all the formats in this visit by West Indies. The tourists have definitely punched above their weight but just haven't had the firepower to stop Pakistan. Another traditional UAE batting surface is expected for this game. West Indies will hope they field better after having dropped several chances in the last game. For the hosts, the strategy will be the same as usual - bat the opposition out of the game. The toss is coming up shortly.
